_notes: Infineon DPS310 barometric pressure and temperature sensor (Adafruit board) at 0x77 (default, SDO high) or 0x76. Also matches the Goertek SPL06-001, which has the same ID, registers and compensation. Detection: PRODUCT_ID (0x0D) = 0x10 (REV_ID 1, PROD_ID 0); a BME280/BME680/BME690 reads otherwise there (a BME690 0x04 on the bench). Init: soft reset (RESET 0x0C = 0x89), 50 ms for the coefficients to be ready; Infineon's temperature correction sequence (0x0E = 0xA5, 0x0F = 0x96, 0x62 = 0x02, 0x0E = 0, 0x0F = 0), without which some chips read temperatures about twice too high; PRS_CFG (0x06) 8 measurements/s, 16x oversampling (27.6 ms each); TMP_CFG (0x07) the external (MEMS) temperature sensor, 8/s, 1x; CFG_REG (0x09) P_SHIFT, needed above 8x pressure oversampling; MEAS_CFG (0x08) continuous pressure and temperature. TMP_CFG's sensor must match the one the coefficients were calibrated with (COEF_SRCE, 0x28 bit 7): the external one on every chip seen (0xA9 on the bench), which the init assumes. Poll: PSR_B2-B0 and TMP_B2-B0 (0x00, 6 bytes, 24-bit two's complement, big-endian) and the coefficients (0x10, 18 bytes); the decode code applies Infineon's compensation (datasheet 4.9) with the scale factors for 16x (pressure, 253952) and 1x (temperature, 524288) oversampling, so a change to PRS_CFG or TMP_CFG oversampling needs them changed too.

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-23): the lone 0x99 + 9-byte read (registers 0x99-0xA1, not in the map) read zeros; configuration, coefficients and COEF_SRCE unchanged and measuring carried on. Its addresses are in Axiom's excluded RSAO range anyway
